description: This file defines an abstract final class `NetworkEnv` that provides environment-based configuration for networking in a Flutter application. It reads configuration values such as API URLs and feature flags from environment variables using the `flutter_dotenv` package, and determines whether the app should operate in mock mode or real network mode based on these settings.

classes.name: NetworkEnv
classes.description: An abstract final class that encapsulates network configuration derived from environment variables, including URLs and feature flags, and provides computed properties to determine operational modes such as mock mode.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the API base URL from environment variables, or an empty string if not set.

methods.name: wsBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket base URL from environment variables, or an empty string if not set.

methods.name: jwtMock
methods.description: Returns the JWT mock token from environment variables, or an empty string if not set.

methods.name: enableOnline
methods.description: Indicates whether online features are enabled based on the environment variable ENABLE_ONLINE.

methods.name: isMockMode
methods.description: Determines if the app should operate in mock mode, based on online enablement and presence of URLs.
